responsibility: This machine-description fragment implements the fixed-length Advanced SIMD/NEON instruction patterns for the AArch64 backend. It contains expanders and insn patterns for vector moves, lane operations, arithmetic, conversions, structure loads/stores, crypto and matrix operations, BF16 support, and other NEON-specific code-generation forms, serving as the RTL-to-assembly description that the generic expander, combine, and builtin code use to emit AArch64 fixed-length vector instructions.
